intent: Design a deterministic, simple JS updater for .arcanum/inventory/index.json (+ index.md row sync).
refinement_objective: MVP-ready non-executed plan for the updater; build is a follow-on task-session.
validation_note: Parent-validated against the canonical 10-stage shape; compact preset; subagent_strategy none. No full dispatch-spec validator invoked (single-capability authoring, no delegation).

overlays.why: ordinary refinement of a well-scoped tool: sequence + frame_handoff + validation_loop + owner_boundary + observability.

'deterministic' is the core promise — it must be falsified by a controlled test: same input -> byte-identical index.json AND idempotent on existing id. Requires an evidence artifact (the test fixture).

subagent_strategy.why: simple, well-scoped tool with no design tension; the canonical loop runs parent-authored.

stages.receipt: define is grounded; the one open fork = write-scope (json-only vs +index.md vs +log.md)
coherent unit = addRecord(record, timestamp) -> deterministic index.json mutation + index.md row
load-bearing risks named: wall-clock breaks determinism (timestamp=input); Python->JS formatting delta (first-run reformat residue); by_evidence_set normalization needs a migration note
repaired: timestamp is a required input; append-only map updates (no key reorder); idempotent on existing id; format-match-or-accept-one-time-reformat decided

gates.note: refine owns seed/dispatch/synthesis; the build is deferred to task-session
